[color=#00ff00]这是一个很多河流的农场。
在农场中可以钓到湖鱼。
有一个额外的种植区，可以通过农场洞穴右边的矿车到达。
默认替换标准农场，可以在配置中修改
This is a farm with many rivers.
You can catch Mountain fish on the farm.
There is an additional planting area that can be reached by mine car on the right side of the farm cave.
Default replacement of standard farm, you can be modified in the config file.[/color]
